name: ground-relay
title: Ground Relay
description: Carry intent, boundaries, evidence, and correction history across AI tools without surrendering context ownership.
author: breyden_taylor

commands.name: create-ground-packet
commands.title: Create Ground Packet
commands.subtitle: Ground Relay
commands.description: Capture portable context from selected text, clipboard content, or manual entry.

commands.name: browse-ground-packets
commands.title: Browse Ground Packets
commands.subtitle: Ground Relay
commands.description: Inspect, correct, and export local Ground Relay packets.

tools.name: draft-ground-packet
tools.title: Draft Ground Packet
tools.description: Draft a non-persistent, portable context packet from stated situation, intent, boundaries, evidence, uncertainty, and next move. Generated claims remain advisory and unverified.

tools.name: find-context-gap
tools.title: Find Context Gap
tools.description: Identify one material missing question in a Ground Relay packet. Returns one question at a time and never scores or grades the carrier.

tools.name: save-ground-packet
tools.title: Save Ground Packet
tools.description: Save a new Ground Relay packet to the extension-local append-only ledger after explicit human confirmation. Saving does not verify claims or grant authority.

ai.instructions: Ground Relay creates portable, contestable context rather than hidden memory or final truth. Keep situation, operative intent, explicit refusals, authority, evidence, uncertainty, and next movement separate. Never treat generated text as a receipt, authority grant, or verified source statement. Ask one material question at a time. Prefer open Markdown and JSON portability. Use save-ground-packet only when the user explicitly asks to persist the packet; Raycast will request confirmation.

evals.input: @ground-relay turn this project brief into a portable ground packet without saving it: We are preparing a private Raycast extension release. The operative intent is to verify the build and preserve a reversible publication path. Do not claim Store acceptance before receipt.

mocks.draft-ground-packet: {"format":"ground-relay.packet","formatVersion":"1.0","status":"ai-candidate","authorityStatus":"advisory-no-authority-grant","draft":{"title":"Private Raycast release","situation":"A private extension is being prepared.","operativeIntent":"Verify the build and preserve a reversible publication path.","explicitRefusals":["Do not claim Store acceptance before receipt."]}}

evals.input: @ground-relay what is the next important thing missing from this packet? Situation: a private extension is ready for validation. Operative intent: run build and publish only after evidence. Explicit refusal: do not treat a draft as accepted.

mocks.find-context-gap: {"field":"authorityBoundary","question":"Who may publish this extension, and what still requires review?","rationale":"Context without authority geometry invites accidental overreach."}

evals.input: @ground-relay save this ground packet locally. Title: Private Raycast release. Situation: the build passed locally. Operative intent: preserve a portable release handoff. Authority boundary: the user authorized local persistence; Store publication remains separate. Next move: inspect the saved packet.
